clue.text: Like surefire investments good pal told Ed about

indicators.note: "about" as in scattered about or turned about, so the letters are moved around into a new order

parts.note: G is the standard abbreviation for good
taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A friend confides in Ed about some safe bets.
explanation.walkthrough: The G for good joins the fodder before the letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A figurative sense: something gold-plated is guaranteed to pay off, as a surefire investment is.

clue.text: Place for putting eco politician

definitions.meaning: putting is the golf stroke, so this is the patch of short grass round the hole
a member of the environmentalist party

explanation.surface: Somewhere to install an environmentalist in office.
explanation.walkthrough: "Putting" reads as placing something, but it is the golf stroke: the putting green.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the golf green where players putt, and a Green, a member of an ecology party.

clue.text: Veg, as a rule, is ground up in meat product

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Vegetables normally get minced into a processed meat.
explanation.walkthrough: "Ground up" fits the sausage-making picture, which hides it as the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by category: the answer is one kind of processed meat, the broad class the clue names.

clue.text: Somewhat socialist US singer

definitions.meaning: a pale shade of red, the colour of the left
the American pop singer who spells her name with an exclamation mark

explanation.surface: An American singer with mildly left-wing views.
explanation.walkthrough: Pink is a watered-down red, hence leaning left without going all the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: pink as slang for mildly left-wing, and P!nk, the US pop star.

clue.text: Mail exposes "Barmy court"

explanation.walkthrough: "Mail" looks like the newspaper, but it is chain mail.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by example: chain mail is one kind of protective metal body covering worn in battle.

clue.text: The Spanish explorer first to discover old legendary city

parts.note: first letter of discover

clue.text: Elgar must have briefly upset composer

something upset is knocked over and jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken letter for letter
HAVE without its last letter

explanation.surface: Edward Elgar was bound to have annoyed a fellow composer.
explanation.walkthrough: One composer's name supplies letters for another's.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by category: the Austrian late-Romantic symphonist is named only by his profession.

clue.text: Spring, when Sergey goes cycling

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: A definition by category: an erupting jet of hot underground water is one kind of spring.

clue.text: Denver uncovered French name for poison

nom is French for name

explanation.walkthrough: "Poison" looks like a noun but is a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, both verbs: to put venom into something is to poison it.

clue.text: Court status where both parties seek to gain advantage

definitions.text: Court status where both parties seek to gain advantage

parts.words: where both parties seek to gain advantage
parts.note: the parties are the two players, and advantage is the next score after it

explanation.surface: A lawsuit in which each side angles for the upper hand.
explanation.walkthrough: The court is a tennis court, the parties are the players, and "advantage" is a literal tennis score.
explanation.definitionFit: At 40-all in tennis, the score is called this, and the next point won gives advantage to that player.

clue.text: Geeky dude involved in dinner date

parts.note: dinNER Date

explanation.surface: A geek on a dinner date.

explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a socially awkward enthusiast is a geek.

clue.text: I hear you are in bistro cooking Mexican food

indicators.note: one thing sits in the middle of another
cooking mixes and transforms ingredients, so the letters are stirred into a new order
what the setter hears is a sound, so write letters that sound like the phrase

parts.note: the letters U and R said together sound like "you are"
BISTRO rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has heard you are at a bistro making tacos and the like.
explanation.walkthrough: The two letters go inside the jumbled bistro, right after its B.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by category: wrapped filled tortillas are one Mexican dish, and the plural matches.

clue.text: Brightly coloured tail of indigo bird

parts.note: blazing bright, the colour of fire

parts.note: last letter of indigo

explanation.surface: A vivid bird with a deep blue tail.

explanation.definitionFit: A definition by category: the pink long-legged wader is one kind of bird.

clue.text: Nobleman pursuing pony, initially one in valuable string

parts.note: first letter of pony
an earl is a British noble

explanation.definitionFit: A definition by description: a necklace of precious beads is made of these, one at a time.

clue.text: Season to pelt with shot?

definitions.meaning: a verb: to flavour food with a spice
to spray a target with many small pellets

explanation.surface: Is it the season for shooting at things?
explanation.walkthrough: "Season" is a verb, as in seasoning food, not a time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: Two verb senses: to add a hot spice to food, and to riddle something with a scatter of shot.

clue.text: One getting tanked up before going to work?

the work is done underwater once the tanks are on

clue.text: Frost seen in California peninsula

clue.text: Letter might carry this page once ready in East Germany

clue.text: Coach regularly buys headgear for men

clue.text: Scottish nobleman's broken leg at home

taken letter for letter
